steps.task: Rewrite video.rs: replace audiowaveform-based pipeline with FFmpeg showwaves animated waveform approach

sub_plan.description: Break video.rs rewrite into atomic sub-tasks

steps.task: Remove audiowaveform-specific constants (BAR_WIDTH, BAR_GAP, WAVEFORM_COLOR_PLAYED, WAVEFORM_COLOR_UNPLAYED, CURSOR_WIDTH, CURSOR_COLOR_HEX) and the render_waveform_audiowaveform() function. Add new showwaves constants: WAVEFORM_MODE='cline', WAVEFORM_COLOR='white', WAVEFORM_SCALE='sqrt', WAVEFORM_START_SECS=0. Keep VIDEO_WIDTH, VIDEO_HEIGHT, WAVEFORM_WIDTH, WAVEFORM_HEIGHT, WAVEFORM_Y_OFFSET, VIDEO_FPS, VIDEO_DURATION_SECS.

decisions: Chose showwaves cline mode over p2p — symmetric centered bars match audiogram aesthetic
Chose white waveform color — single color since animation is real-time, not played/unplayed

steps.task: Rewrite compose_video() to use a single FFmpeg invocation with filter_complex: [1:a]showwaves=s=WxH:mode=cline:rate=30:colors=white:scale=sqrt:draw=full → colorkey=black:0.01:0.15 → overlay on scaled/cropped background image. Only 2 inputs needed (image + audio) instead of 4. Remove timecode textfile generation, drawbox cursor, drawtext timecode, split[bg1][bg2] dual-waveform overlay trick. Support -ss START -t DURATION for time range selection.

decisions: Chose colorkey over geq alpha approach — simpler, no risk since waveform is white on black
Removed timecode/cursor overlay for cleaner animated waveform look
learnings: showwaves always renders on opaque black background — colorkey=black:0.01:0.15 makes it transparent

steps.task: Add new public function generate_and_store_artist_videos(state: Arc<AppState>, artist_id: i64) that: loads artist from DB, for each track with a key calls generate_track_preview_video(), uploads result to R2 at artists/{id}/track{n}_video/preview.mp4 via storage::upload_file_named(), updates DB row with track1_video_key/track2_video_key, logs success/failure per track. Uses pic_overlay_key → pic_cropped_key → pic_key preference order for background image.

decisions: R2 key pattern: artists/{id}/track1_video/preview.mp4 — follows existing {type}/{name} convention
Background image preference: overlay → cropped → original (same as Instagram posting)
knowledge.notes: This function will be called from tokio::spawn in submit handlers and synchronously from the manual regenerate endpoint

steps.task: Update the test_constants_are_consistent test to reflect removed constants (BAR_WIDTH, BAR_GAP) and add a test for the showwaves filter_complex string construction

decisions: Removed audiowaveform CLI dependency entirely — FFmpeg handles everything
Keep same public function signature for generate_track_preview_video() so instagram.rs callers need minimal changes

output.summary: Completed: Rewrite video.rs: replace audiowaveform-based pipeline with FFmpeg showwaves ani
